questions.text: $\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{x}(\sqrt{1+x}-\sqrt{1-x})=?$

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: A heavy uniform rod balances about a fulcrum placed at a distance $c$ from one end when a weight $P$ is suspended from that end. When the weight $P$ is replaced by weight $Q$, the rod balances about a fulcrum placed at a distance $d$ from the same end. Show that the weight of the rod is $\frac{P c-Q d}{d-c}$.

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: The points $A(5,3), B(-2,0)$ and $C(1,1)$ are on a circle. Find the distance between the center of the circle and center of gravity of the triangle $A B C$.

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: $\mathrm{ABC}$ is an isosceles right-angled triangle. The length of each of the equal sides $\mathrm{AB}$ and $\mathrm{AC}$ is $4 \mathrm{~m}$ and the moments of a force about the points A, B and C are 8, 8, and $16 \mathrm{~kg}-\mathrm{m}$, respectively. Find the magnitude and line of action of the force.

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: If a survey of the use of computers in certain commercial area of a city, it is seen that $95 \%$ use laptor computers and $10 \%$ use IBM computers. What is the percentage of laptop computer users who do not us IBM computers?

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: A committee of 6 members is to be formed from 6 students having mathematics and 4 students having physics. In how many ways can the committee be formed so that the majority of members of the committee is taken from the students having mathematics?

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: The first three terms of a binomial expansion of $(x+a)^{n}$ are 729,7290 , and 30375 , respectively. Find the value of $\mathrm{a}$.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: An engine pumps $500 \mathrm{~kg}$ water in a minute from a well of $200 \mathrm{~m}$ depth. If there is wastage of $20 \%$ power then what is the real power of the engine?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: What will be the density of lead at $2 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~N} \mathrm{~m}^{-2}$ pressure if it has normal density $11.4 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$ and bulk modulus $0.8 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{Nm}^{-2}$ ?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A typical 60W GSL lamp is replaced with a 13W CFL lamp to reduce power consumption. The bulbs cost TK 30 and Tk respectively. 250. At Tk 4 per unit of electricity, how many hours on average should the CFL bulb be lit per day to cover the cost of replacing the bulb in one year?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: The energy required to remove an electron from sodium is $2.3 \mathrm{eV}$. Does sodium show photoclectric effect for orange light of wavelength $680 \mathrm{~nm}$ ?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A bullet is fired from a gun located in the ground to hit an object falling from $300 \mathrm{~m}$ height. The distance between the gun and the object is $500 \mathrm{~m}$ at the time of firing. The bullet leaves the gun at the same instant that the object falls from the rest. Calculate the firing angle of the gun.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: The intensities of sound of a vacuum cleaner and a TV set are $80 \mathrm{~dB}$ and $78 \mathrm{~dB}$, respectively. What is the combined intensity of sound of them?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: Determine the critical angle of glass with respect to water when the critical angle of glass with respect to air is $42^{\circ}$ and the critical angle of water with respect to air $48^{\circ}$.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A proton with an energy of 8.0 MeV enters a magnetic field of strength 5.0 T at right angles. What is the magnetic force on the proton?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: The area of a black body is $3 \times 10^{-8} \mathrm{~m}^{2}$ and its temperature is $727^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. What is the rate of emission of heat of the body? At what temperature the rate of emission will be three times of its original value? [Stefan's constant $=5.7 \times 10^{-8} \mathrm{Wm}^{-2} \mathrm{~K}^{-4}$ ]

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: $1.0 \mathrm{~g}$ of a metal carbonate salt is dissolved in $25.0 \mathrm{~mL} 1.0 \mathrm{M} \mathrm{HCl}$ solution. $50.0 \mathrm{~mL}$ decimolar solution of causti soda is required to neutralise the resulting solution completely. Calculate the molecular weight and molecular formula of the salt.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: $400 \mathrm{~mL}$ of $0.1 \mathrm{M} \mathrm{NaOH}$ is added to $600 \mathrm{~mL}$ of $0.2 \mathrm{M}$ acetic acid to prepare a buffer solution. What is the $\mathrm{pH}$ of the buffer solution? (for acetic acid $\mathrm{pK}_{\mathrm{a}}=4.76$ )

(b) Which of $\mathrm{HNO}_{3}$ and $\mathrm{H}_{3} \mathrm{PO}_{4}$ is stronger? Justify your answer.

questions.subject: english
questions.text:

(a) How did Galileo contribute to science?
(b) What did Galileo do with his telescope?
